title: O&M Shift leader
description: Official Vanderlande airport-operations and maintenance role in Saudi Arabia for baggage handling systems support. The role leads shift-level operation, service, and maintenance execution for BHS environments, serves as the primary responder to operational and technical incidents, coordinates a maintenance team across preventive and corrective work, troubleshoots mechanical, electrical, and control systems, interprets engineering drawings and technical documentation, communicates system status to stakeholders, and manages work orders and maintenance activity through CMMS tools including Maximo. The listing emphasizes safety, system availability, reliability, contractual service performance, and operational excellence.
